notes: Scale bar is about 43 px/m. The model is a steel lattice windmill: 18-blade wheel 3.2 m across, hub at 7.65 m, tower base 2.6 m, wheel facing +z, tail vane to -z. It stands at -x beside a 5.1 m x 1.6 m corrugated tank on a 0.45 m earth pad. In front (+x,+z) is a 6.55 m galvanised trough on 3 concrete blocks, running from -1.1 to +5.45 m from the tank centre as Front and Back show. A mud patch ends at x = 6.15 m. Pipes run from the pump to the tank lid and from the tank to the trough end. The sheet is inconsistent in places. The Top view draws the tail pointing -x, which contradicts the Side view; I modelled it to -z and left that tail out of the Top box. The Top view also shifts the trough and mud about 2 m further +x; I followed Front and Back. The trough z is a compromise between Top (3.0 m) and Side (4.2 m). The Side box is cropped at the trough block to leave out a thin ground strip that the Top view doesn't support.
